prompt:
We're building a legal contract management system on our Vapor backend. We need to add a `Contract` entity to the database. Here's what a Contract needs:

- Fields: `title` (string), `contractNumber` (string), `status` (string), `effectiveDate` (date)
- Every contract must be owned by a `LegalUser` (who created it). The `LegalUser` model already exists.
- Contracts can contain multiple `Clause` records, and the same `Clause` can appear in multiple contracts (many-to-many). The `Clause` model already exists.

The `ContractFields` protocol already exists in `Sources/SharedViewModels/FieldModels/ContractFields.swift` — do not regenerate it.

Please generate all the necessary server-side persistence files for the `Contract` entity, including any supporting structures needed for the many-to-many relationship. Also update `Sources/LegalServer/database.swift` to register the new migrations.
